For frequent domestic flights, I’d shortlist these three:

Offer	Price	Reliability / durability	Important limitation
Safari Cargo Neo 55cm	~₹4,899	Polycarbonate, TSA lock, 8 spinner wheels, 5-year warranty	~3 kg; verify current stock/colour
American Tourister Purimax 55cm	~₹5,096	Polycarbonate, TSA lock, established service network	Warranty is shorter than Safari’s
Mokobara Transit Cabin Pro 56cm	~₹6,499–6,799	4.4/5 from ~500 verified reviews; spare-wheel/handle support	Some reported handle failures; pricier

Safari and American Tourister have broad Indian distribution, while Mokobara offers more repair-oriented support.
